blocks.text: Define a simple API contract: create job, fetch status, and deliver image URLs.
Expose a generate endpoint that returns a job id, then a status endpoint for polling or a stream endpoint for realtime updates.

Contract checks:
- Create is idempotent before a job ID exists and returns a status URL.
- Every job transition has a unique monotonic version.
- Polling and optional streaming expose the same lifecycle model.
- Cancel and retry require command identity plus the observed job version.
- Output URLs carry safe display metadata.

blocks.title: Core interfaces
rows: Creates or recovers one long-running job for the idempotency key.
UI polls with backoff or resumes a stream. Progress can be indeterminate.
Optional realtime updates that may omit a numeric percentage.
Retry requeues a confirmed failed job; cancel records intent, and both return a newer job version.
Result is served from object storage.

blocks.title: Public behavior
items: idempotent create, retry, and cancel commands

blocks.title: Job-monitor internals
items: binary image blobs in API responses

steps.title: 1. Create job
steps.text: Persist the create idempotency key first, accept 202 Accepted, store job ID, statusUrl, and version, and monitor that Location resource.

steps.title: 2. Watch status
steps.text: Poll with backoff or resume a lifecycle stream. Show a spinner or elapsed state when the service cannot produce trustworthy numeric progress.

steps.title: 3. Render output
steps.text: Display the image from the CDN URL.

blocks.title: Contract checkpoint
blocks.text: Keep the contract minimal and job-based. That is the simplest reliable way to ship an MVP quickly.

Create returns 202 Accepted with Location, statusUrl, job ID, and version. Monitoring uses conditional polling or resumable events. Cancel and retry are idempotent versioned commands. The service assigns a unique monotonically increasing version to every transition; equal-version contradictions cause refetch. Job progress may be absent, and image URLs are rendered under a restrictive content policy.

steps.title: Create idempotent generation job
steps.text: Snapshot prompt, allocate an idempotency key, and accept an asynchronous job resource.

steps.title: Monitor versioned status resource
steps.text: Poll with backoff or resume events while exposing freshness and honest progress.

steps.title: Reconcile job and command versions
steps.text: Apply only newer job versions and resolve command responses in any order.

steps.title: Render capability-safe output
steps.text: Reserve image geometry, validate metadata, and expose download or retry according to capability.
